catalog_note: Core labels, settings help and recovery guidance are translated. Specialist controls remain in English. Interface and OCR languages are independent. Native-speaker and visual acceptance remain pending.
template_error: Interface message could not be formatted.
error.unknown.title: An operation needs attention
error.unknown.check.0: Note the stage and error code without sharing source content.
error.unknown.action.0: Inspect local recovery information or export a sanitized support bundle.
help.ui.shortcuts: Configurable keyboard actions. Duplicate combinations, text-editing/window controls and Ctrl+Alt international input combinations are rejected. Review actions run only with the keyboard-review button focused; editors keep their normal shortcuts.
help.ui.shortcuts.import: Import scans shortcut; default Ctrl+O. Ignored while a text editor has focus.
help.ui.shortcuts.palette: Open the command palette; default Ctrl+K. Ignored while a text editor has focus.
help.ui.shortcuts.save: Save the current review draft; default Ctrl+S. Requires the review shortcut focus scope.
help.ui.shortcuts.approve: Save and approve the current page; default Ctrl+Enter. Held keys do not approve successive pages.
help.ui.shortcuts.next_issue: Move to the next undeferred review issue; default Ctrl+J.
help.ui.shortcuts.defer: Defer the selected issue for this open review session; default Ctrl+D.
help.ui.shortcuts.undo: Undo a review revision; default Ctrl+Z. Text editors keep their own text undo.
help.ui.shortcuts.redo: Redo a review revision; default Ctrl+Y. Text editors keep their own text redo.
help.ui.locale: Interface labels, settings help and error remedies: en (English), si (Sinhala), ta (Tamil). OCR language and model support are configured separately.
help.ui: Appearance preferences do not invalidate recognition checkpoints.
help.ui.accent: RGB highlight color, components from 0 to 255.
help.ui.scale: Scale controls and text for readability.
help.ui.idle_fps: Refresh limit while idle. Lower values use fewer resources.
help.ui.reduced_motion: Reduce nonessential movement for comfort and resource use.
help.ui.fps: Maximum animation refresh rate while active.
help.ui.background: RGB background color, components from 0 to 255.
help.ui.autosave: Save desktop settings and queue between sessions. Conversion checkpoints save independently.
help.experience: Live-view and update-check preferences do not affect recognition results.
help.experience.live_preview: Show the source region and generated draft answer. Drafts may change; private reasoning channels are never shown.
help.experience.warm_reader: Opt in to retaining at most one owned compatible local reader process between successful jobs. Off by default. Each reuse requires a verified reset and fresh memory admission. Retention sessions and hardware trials stay cold; release immediately from the workspace. Native image buffers may remain in RAM until the process exits; this is logical isolation, not forensic erasure.
help.experience.warm_reader_ttl_secs: Idle expiry for the optional retained reader, from 1 to 60 seconds (default 30). Expiry, changed preferences, cancellation, errors or app exit release the owned process; external servers are never cached.
help.experience.check_updates: Check official publishers at most daily when idle. Downloads need your click; no document content is sent.
help.experience.update_channel: App update channel: stable excludes preview releases; preview explicitly opts in to newer prereleases. Runtime and reader publisher channels are unchanged. Switching channels never installs or downgrades the app.
help.experience.defer_updates_until: Optional UTC time until which automatic publisher checks are deferred. Check all updates now bypasses this deferral. It does not schedule downloads or change recognition checkpoints.
help.tessdata_dir: Verified optional printed-OCR resource folder. Empty uses bundled/system Tesseract data. Interface language is independent.
help.preset: Fast: printed OCR. Balanced: AI as needed. Accuracy: independent OCR and vision. Maximum: a third reader family and more checks.
help.automatic_models: Choose the strongest installed readers fitting currently available memory. Disable to choose model_ids manually.
help.model_ids: Reader IDs to allow when automatic selection is off. Manage readers in Studio.
help.handwriting: Extra care for handwriting and difficult scans. Requires AI; switches Fast to Accuracy.
help.languages: Installed Tesseract language codes joined with +, for example eng+sin. Matching traineddata files are required.
help.page_range: Pages starting at 1. Blank means all; examples: 1-4,8.
help.dpi: Page render resolution. 0 is automatic. Higher values retain small writing but cost memory and time.
help.max_pixels: Maximum pixels per rendered page, protecting memory on very large scans.
help.image_edge: Longest AI image edge. 0 uses the reader recommendation. Smaller values can lose fine writing.
help.tile_edge: Pixel size of detailed region crops for re-reading difficult areas.
help.tile_overlap: Crop overlap as a fraction, helping avoid words cut at boundaries.
help.crop_retries: Maximum extra region readings per page. More retries cost additional time.
help.consensus_min: Minimum independent reader evidence for agreement. Repeated output from one family is not independent.
help.agreement_threshold: Required similarity between independent readings. Conflicting numbers stay as observed alternatives; never averaged.
help.review_threshold: Mark low-confidence regions for review. Model confidence is not a calibrated accuracy probability.
help.backend: Auto selects compatible CUDA, Vulkan or CPU. GPU presence alone does not prove accelerated inference.
help.gpu_index: Optional device index. Null selects the GPU with most available memory.
help.ram_fraction: Fraction of free system RAM available for recognition, from 0 to 1.
help.vram_fraction: Fraction of free GPU memory available for recognition. Leave headroom for other apps.
help.reserve_ram_mib: Extra system memory to keep free in MiB. 1024 MiB equals 1 GiB.
help.reserve_vram_mib: Extra GPU memory to keep free, in MiB.
help.cpu_threads: Inference workers. 0 is automatic. Optimize for this PC measures candidate counts.
help.context: Model context token budget. 0 is adaptive. Larger contexts use more memory.
help.max_tokens: Maximum answer tokens per request. Truncated results are rejected; increase for dense pages.
help.batch: Prompt processing batch size. 0 is automatic. Large values can use more memory.
help.micro_batch: Physical inference micro-batch size. 0 is automatic; reduce for memory pressure.
help.image_tokens: Image token budget for compatible readers. 0 is automatic.
help.gpu_layers: Layers to offload. -1 requests full offload. Actual offload is checked in native logs.
help.flash_attention: Use memory-efficient attention when the runtime supports it.
help.projector_on_cpu: Encode images on CPU to save VRAM; this may be slower.
help.kv_cache: Attention-cache precision. q8_0 balances memory and fidelity; support depends on the runtime.
help.temperature: Sampling randomness. Lower values make transcription more repeatable.
help.top_p: Sampling probability cutoff. Usually keep the default for faithful reading.
help.seed: Sampling seed. Different hardware can still produce different results.
help.request_timeout_secs: Time limit for one reader request. Slow CPU inference may need more time.
help.allow_cpu_offload: Allow readers to spill into system RAM beyond VRAM. This can be much slower.
help.require_acceleration: Reject inference unless the managed runtime confirms GPU layer offload.
help.tesseract: Printed OCR executable path. Windows installers include English language data.
help.pdfium: Path or folder of the compatible PDF rendering library, included in installers.
help.server: Native llama-server executable. Verified setup and runtime updates manage this path.
help.models_dir: Folder holding local reader registrations and versioned weights. Requires sufficient disk space.
help.shared_model_store: Immutable verified assets shared by compatible projects, indexed by SHA256 and byte length. Registrations remain local; this store does not automatically delete assets.
help.project_lock: Optional exact project environment lock file. When set, validate its pinned readers, runtime, OCR resources and preparation settings before recognition; mismatches stop instead of silently upgrading.
help.endpoint: Literal localhost endpoint for an external inference server. Remote conversion endpoints are blocked.
help.external_server: Use a separately managed local inference server instead of launching the bundled runtime.
help.subject: Background context for interpretation. Context cannot justify inventing unreadable words.
help.writer: Confirmed local handwriting examples and profile, managed in Studio > Writers.
help.writer.root: Folder for writer profiles and confirmed examples, retained as user data.
help.writer.id: Selected writer ID; null means no profile.
help.writer.use_examples: Supply relevant confirmed examples to compatible readers. This does not retrain model weights.
help.assistance: Questions and background references used during recognition.
help.assistance.ask_questions: Pause for useful clarification. Questions may be skipped; uncertain text stays marked for review.
help.assistance.max_questions: Maximum questions per batch, up to 32.
help.assistance.web_lookup: Allow explicit public-topic lookup. Scans are never sent to public search.
help.assistance.glossary: Confirmed subject terms, used as background rather than transcription evidence.
help.assistance.sources: Public reference excerpts chosen for context, not transcription evidence.
help.auto_rotate: Detect page orientation. Disable when scans are already correctly oriented.
help.preserve_figures: Keep source diagram crops in Word beside their descriptions.
help.keep_page_breaks: Keep original page boundaries in exported Word documents.
help.font: Font for editable Word text. Writer font packs are exported separately.
help.font_size: Editable Word text size in points.
error.NG100.title: Input cannot be read
error.NG100.check.0: Check the selected file, supported format and page range.
error.NG100.action.0: Choose a readable local copy or export the scan as an RGB PNG.
error.NG102.title: Settings need attention
error.NG102.check.0: Check the named setting and its allowed range.
error.NG102.action.0: Restore a valid value or a known settings template before retrying.
error.NG110.title: Printed recognition is unavailable
error.NG110.check.0: Check Tesseract, the selected language files and the native program error.
error.NG110.action.0: Install verified language resources or select a compatible reader. Ask your administrator about blocked programs; do not bypass system policy.
error.NG200.title: The reader cannot run with the available resources
error.NG200.check.0: Check free RAM/VRAM and the matching model, projector and runtime backend.
error.NG200.action.0: Close heavy applications, choose a smaller reader or image size, or repair the verified runtime. Resume the saved project.
error.NG202.title: The reader cannot run with the available resources
error.NG202.check.0: Check free RAM/VRAM and the matching model, projector and runtime backend.
error.NG202.action.0: Close heavy applications, choose a smaller reader or image size, or repair the verified runtime. Resume the saved project.
error.NG300.title: The reader cannot run with the available resources
error.NG300.check.0: Check free RAM/VRAM and the matching model, projector and runtime backend.
error.NG300.action.0: Close heavy applications, choose a smaller reader or image size, or repair the verified runtime. Resume the saved project.
error.NG201.title: The reader returned an incomplete answer
error.NG201.check.0: Compare the source image with the preserved candidates and uncertain values.
error.NG201.action.0: Reread the affected region or correct it manually. Do not approve uncertain numbers only because readers agree.
error.NG203.title: The reader address is not allowed
error.NG203.check.0: Only a permitted literal loopback address may be used for a local reader; redirects and remote addresses are blocked.
error.NG203.action.0: Use the compatible local reader address shown by setup.
error.NG400.title: The output could not be published safely
error.NG400.check.0: Check free disk space, folder permissions, open Word files and existing output names.
error.NG400.action.0: Close the open output and choose a writable external destination with a new filename. Keep existing checkpoints and outputs.
error.NG401.title: The output could not be published safely
error.NG401.check.0: Check free disk space, folder permissions, open Word files and existing output names.
error.NG401.action.0: Close the open output and choose a writable external destination with a new filename. Keep existing checkpoints and outputs.
error.NG500.title: The saved project does not match its inputs
error.NG500.check.0: Check source hashes, pinned settings and model versions, and any pending recovery report.
error.NG500.action.0: Restore the matching environment or recover a saved backup. Use a new project for intentionally changed inputs.
error.NG610.title: A confirmed correction needs attention
error.NG610.check.0: Compare the selected source crop and block with the explicitly confirmed text.
error.NG610.action.0: Reopen the affected block, confirm the visible text and use a shorter clarification. Quarantine incorrect learned examples.
error.NG630.title: A confirmed correction needs attention
error.NG630.check.0: Compare the selected source crop and block with the explicitly confirmed text.
error.NG630.action.0: Reopen the affected block, confirm the visible text and use a shorter clarification. Quarantine incorrect learned examples.
error.NG620.title: The handwriting font needs confirmed samples
error.NG620.check.0: Check that every required character or explicitly joined cluster has a usable, confirmed sample.
error.NG620.action.0: Collect missing samples and export to a new font filename. Unconfirmed joining must not be inferred.
error.NG640.title: The optional public lookup is unavailable
error.NG640.check.0: Check the explicitly chosen public topic and the connection.
error.NG640.action.0: Retry the public query or continue offline. Do not send private scan text as a public query.
error.NG650.title: A verified asset operation did not finish
error.NG650.check.0: Check disk space, the network, the pinned publisher revision and the reported verification error.
error.NG650.action.0: Resume the download or repair the selected verified asset. Preserve the active installation and rollback files.
error.NG660.title: The candidate did not pass validation
error.NG660.check.0: Inspect the exact prepared candidate and its canary validation report.
error.NG660.action.0: Keep the current active installation. Repair or replace the candidate before requesting activation again.
error.NG661.title: An activation transaction needs recovery
error.NG661.check.0: Preserve the pending candidates and activation journal; check for conflicting settings or registry changes.
error.NG661.action.0: Retry recovery with the same settings. Keep the working installation until the journal reports a completed or restored transaction.
error.NG670.title: The project environment lock does not match
error.NG670.check.0: Compare the locked reader, runtime, resources and preparation settings with the current environment.
error.NG670.action.0: Restore the pinned environment or explicitly create a new project lock for the intended changes.
error.NG680.title: The confidential session needs attention
error.NG680.check.0: Inspect the marked session and any interrupted-cleanup recovery report.
error.NG680.action.0: Keep the artifacts until completed work is exported or a recovery archive is saved. Recover interrupted cleanup before discarding tracked data.
error.NG682.title: The encrypted workspace needs attention
error.NG682.check.0: Check credentials, private file permissions and any reported retained plaintext paths.
error.NG682.action.0: Preserve the original, work copy and recovery key. Retry the explicit lock or export operation; a workspace is not fully locked while plaintext remains.
error.NG710.title: The evaluation manifest is invalid
error.NG710.check.0: Check source permissions, unique sample IDs, writer-separated splits and prediction coverage.
error.NG710.action.0: Correct the manifest or split oversized samples. Use only permission-cleared ground truth.
error.NG720.title: The hardware plan needs a fresh preview
error.NG720.check.0: Check reserved CPU cores, free memory and settings changed since the preview.
error.NG720.action.0: Create a fresh preview and leave at least one usable worker and the required memory reserve.
error.NG730.title: The support or repair preview is stale
error.NG730.check.0: Check attachment limits, availability and the current file fingerprints.
error.NG730.action.0: Create a fresh preview, select fewer attachments or use a new output filename.
error.NG740.title: The language resource or route needs attention
error.NG740.check.0: Check verified Tesseract language codes and the route's source binding.
error.NG740.action.0: Install the pinned resources or create a fresh route after source changes. The interface language does not select OCR languages.
error.NG750.title: The secure credential store is unavailable
error.NG750.check.0: Check the current user account and the native credential-store error.
error.NG750.action.0: Retry the secure credential operation or remove it through the interface. Do not put tokens in logs or plaintext settings.
error.NG900.title: The operation was cancelled
error.NG900.check.0: Completed stages remain saved; an interrupted export may need a fresh preview.
error.NG900.action.0: Resume with the same inputs and settings, or keep the saved project for later.
error.NG901.title: Saved work is yielding to an urgent job
error.NG901.check.0: Completed stages are saved and the queued job still has its resume settings.
error.NG901.action.0: Wait for the urgent job to finish; the saved stages will resume automatically.
